expected.charges: Possession of explosive materials and unlawful possession of assault firearms — bomb-making chemicals, roughly ten pounds of thermite, trigger mechanisms and two Cobray M11 assault weapons found at his Ridgewood, New Jersey apartment on November 16, 2012. He was not charged with an active plot to bomb anything.
expected.convicted: Yes — convicted in December 2018 of possessing the explosive materials, acquitted of creating a risk of widespread harm, with the jury hung on two weapons counts; convicted on the weapons charges at a second trial on January 18, 2019.
expected.sentence: 25 years in New Jersey state prison. Died in custody April 22, 2020, before proposed compassionate release; death is not recorded as release. The existing November 2012 admission has month precision, so the former 2729-day exact duration is unsupported. Exact admission and intervening institution transfers remain unresolved.
